item.title: October Lantern 0.6.20
item.description:
Pro AI or Lite AI, your choice

  • Ask Lantern has a Pro AI / Lite AI menu next to the message box. Pro AI is our smartest; Lite AI is free. Pro AI comes with Lantern Lifetime, a trial or an October plan.
  • Settings › Account says which one you're on, with a way to upgrade on a free account.
  • When you start an October agent or a routine, you can pick Pro AI or Lite AI there too.

Agent chats and Ask, on Mac

  • A card in Waiting opens its chat in one click, wherever you click on it.
  • Drag across a reply to select all of it, or use Copy to take the whole message.
  • Ask shows the answer to a follow-up, even a long one, and keeps a task's replies as the agent moves on.
  • When an agent stops for your answer, Ask shows the question. If it's one you answer in the agent's terminal, Ask says so, with Open agent.
  • The agent chat no longer cuts off halfway: it scrolls as one, and whatever is waiting on you stays pinned at the top.
  • If you start a new conversation in an agent (/clear or /new), your next message goes there as its own task.

The Windows installer isn't code-signed yet: if Windows shows "Windows protected your PC", click More info, then Run anyway.
